---
title: "DuckDB"
subtitle: "Querying the regions with SQL, directly from the URL"
---

[DuckDB](https://duckdb.org/) reads GeoParquet over HTTP, and with the
[spatial extension](https://duckdb.org/docs/extensions/spatial/overview) the geometry column is a
`GEOMETRY`. The same SQL works in the DuckDB CLI, and from R, Python, or the browser. Code on this page
is not run when the site is built.

## Setup

```sql
INSTALL spatial;
LOAD spatial;
SET VARIABLE base = 'https://australianantarcticdivision.github.io/measoshapes/data/v06';
```

## Read

```sql
SELECT name, label, fill
FROM read_parquet(getvariable('base') || '/measo_regions06_ll.parquet');
```

## Assign regions to points

DuckDB spatial works in the plane, which matches the regions' definition (boundaries straight in
longitude/latitude), so longitude/latitude points are tested against `measo_regions06_ll` directly:

```sql
WITH pts AS (
  SELECT * FROM (VALUES (147.3, -50.2), (100.5, -60.5), (-10.5, -70.5), (-82.5, -45.5), (171.5, -65.5), (-175.5, -65.5))
    AS t(lon, lat)
)
SELECT pts.lon, pts.lat, r.name, r.sector, r.zone
FROM pts
LEFT JOIN read_parquet(getvariable('base') || '/measo_regions06_ll.parquet') AS r
  ON ST_Within(ST_Point(pts.lon, pts.lat), r.geometry)
ORDER BY ALL;
```

For a table of your own, replace `pts` with e.g. `read_csv('obs.csv')`.

Many boundaries run along whole or half degrees of longitude and latitude, so data on a regular grid can
fall exactly on a boundary. Such a point is *within* neither region; use `ST_Intersects` instead of
`ST_Within` to get both regions (and then choose one).

## Areas

Use the polar equal area version:

```sql
SELECT name, round(ST_Area(geometry) / 1e6) AS area_km2
FROM read_parquet(getvariable('base') || '/measo_regions06.parquet')
ORDER BY area_km2 DESC;
```

## From R and Python

```r
library(duckdb)
con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
dbExecute(con, "INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;")
dbGetQuery(con, "SELECT name, sector, zone FROM read_parquet('https://australianantarcticdivision.github.io/measoshapes/data/v06/measo_regions06_ll.parquet')")
```

```python
import duckdb
duckdb.sql("INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;")
duckdb.sql("SELECT name, sector, zone FROM read_parquet('https://australianantarcticdivision.github.io/measoshapes/data/v06/measo_regions06_ll.parquet')")
```

In the browser, DuckDB-Wasm runs the same queries: see [Web](web.qmd).
